description: Add plugins to an existing Databricks AppKit project. Covers Lakebase (PostgreSQL), Analytics (SQL queries + dashboards), Genie (natural language AI/BI), Files (UC Volumes), and Serving (Model Serving / Agent endpoints). Guides through plugin registration, environment variables, app.yaml configuration, and frontend integration. Use when asked to add a plugin to an existing app, integrate Lakebase, add analytics, connect a Genie space, enable file uploads, add a serving endpoint, or extend an AppKit project with new capabilities. Triggers on "add plugin", "add lakebase", "add analytics", "add genie", "add files plugin", "add serving", "add agent endpoint", "integrate postgres", "add database", "add dashboards", "add file browser", "extend app", "connect genie space", "model serving plugin". Not for creating a Lakebase project or managing Lakebase via CLI -- use the databricks-lakebase agent skill for that.
